strings.name: Alexia Putellas
strings.summary: Raised in Catalonia, Putellas trained at several clubs and played for Espanyol and Levante before joining Barcelona in 2012. Her midfield creativity, attack and leadership contributed to the team’s Champions League breakthrough, and she won consecutive Women’s Ballon d’Or awards. Returning after a serious knee injury, she helped Spain win the 2023 World Cup. In 2026 she moved to London City Lionesses, beginning an English league chapter.
